run_install_symlink_cli: run the InstallSymlink CLI to create a symlink from source to dest in an install directory
run_install_symlink_dir: run the InstallSymlink CLI with the -d flag to create a directory symlink
run_install_symlink_mode: run the InstallSymlink CLI with the -m flag to set a custom directory mode
test_install_symlink_function: test the install_symlink function to verify it creates symlinks and skips existing ones
review_install_symlink_function: review the install_symlink function to understand how it handles duplicate symlinks and directory creation
